objective: Fan out two local file tasks and verify their joined artifacts.

left.instructions:
Run the script below with anchor_run using command=["sh","-c",script]. No research. After exit 0, call final_result with summary="left result verified", route="join". Do not repeat a successful command.
set -eu
test ! -e result.txt; test ! -e effects.txt
printf 'seed input:\n'; cat /in/seed/seed.txt
printf seed | cmp - /in/seed/seed.txt
printf '\nseed bytes verified\n'
cat /in/seed/seed.txt > result.txt
printf L >> result.txt
printf 'once\n' > effects.txt
printf 'left result:\n'; cat result.txt
printf '\neffects:\n'; cat effects.txt

right.instructions:
Run the script below with anchor_run using command=["sh","-c",script]. No research. After exit 0, call final_result with summary="right result verified", route="join". Do not repeat a successful command.
set -eu
test ! -e result.txt; test ! -e effects.txt
printf 'seed input:\n'; cat /in/seed/seed.txt
printf seed | cmp - /in/seed/seed.txt
printf '\nseed bytes verified\n'
cat /in/seed/seed.txt > result.txt
printf R >> result.txt
printf 'once\n' > effects.txt
printf 'right result:\n'; cat result.txt
printf '\neffects:\n'; cat effects.txt

seed.run: sh -c 'set -eu; printf seed > seed.txt; cat seed.txt'
